evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids game creation or imposes incompatible constraints on creating games.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with joining via URL and estimator participation; no story disallows URL-based invites.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a different input mechanism that would make this impossible; item management stories complement it.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with other stories that add/select/edit/delete items; no contradictory visibility rule exists.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Aligns with re-estimation and item list viewing; no story prevents selecting prior items.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits adding items; consistent with viewing and selecting items.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story states items are immutable; compatible with item management.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires permanent retention of all items; deletion is not contradicted elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with the rule that estimates are shown only after all estimators have estimated to ensure independence.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with entering an agreed estimate and auto-filling when unanimous; no story forbids averaging.

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Does not contradict manual entry or averaging; it is a conditional convenience feature.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with other acceptance mechanisms (average/unanimous); no incompatible constraint is stated.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with selecting items for re-estimation and viewing prior rounds; no story forbids re-estimation.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Coexists with copy/paste as an alternative input method; no story disallows importing.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Alternative to importing; not an incompatible requirement.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with viewing/exporting transcripts; deletion stories only remove data when invoked.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with exporting transcripts and browsing games; no story prohibits transcripts.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with viewing transcripts and CSV export; no conflicting export format constraint.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with viewing transcripts and HTML export; no conflicting export format constraint.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Does not inherently contradict transcript viewing/exporting because those apply to existing games; deletion is an optional action.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with login, password reminder, and account management; no story forbids accounts.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with account creation and password reminder; no alternative authentication requirement conflicts.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: No other story states account details cannot be changed; consistent with account lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Does not conflict with browsing/viewing/exporting games because those features apply while the account/games exist; deletion is an explicit action.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates a fixed timezone display.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with account/login stories; no story prohibits email-based reminders.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: No other story fixes the card set to a single sequence; ordering consistency can still hold within a chosen set.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires more than 15 or an unlimited number of estimators.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with moderator URL invites; no story requires account login for estimators to join.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with moderator selecting items and participants scrolling through items.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with moderator viewing all items and item list management.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Does not require revealing estimate values; compatible with keeping values hidden until reveal.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Incompatible with the moderator being able to show all estimates immediately before all estimators have estimated.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with changing estimates until draw completion; aligns with the general 'not completed' condition.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with storing results in a non-identifiable way; showing per-estimator history implies identifiable linkage of estimates to an individual.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with storing results in a non-identifiable way if 'who' is retained/available as identifiable data for analysis/storage.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits a shared timer; consistent with timer reset behavior.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with having a shared timer; no contradictory reset rule exists.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with transcripts and re-estimation; no story forbids access to prior-round information during a game.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with choosing between card sets; ordering can remain consistent within the selected set.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Same rule as PP-034 expressed more generally; not incompatible.

evaluations.evidence: thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits showing participant photos; privacy/non-identifiable storage is about research results storage, not necessarily in-game display.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires non-compliance; compatible with accessibility and browser support goals.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No other story contradicts having shared definitions.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes constraints that would prevent indexing; aligns with performance goals.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires dropping support for these browsers; compatible with standards/accessibility aims.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes incompatible UI/tech constraints; compatible with standards and browser support.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires slow responses; consistent with indexing/performance-related work.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: No other story restricts character sets or mandates ASCII-only input.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with URL-based invitations; no story requires opaque/unpredictable URLs.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates exposing raw errors or forbids custom error pages.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Incompatible with stories requiring per-estimator identifiable estimate histories or attribution of estimates to specific individuals.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics can be aggregated and does not inherently contradict non-identifiable storage; no explicit incompatible constraint is stated.
